research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Patreon is researching systems and methods for a membership platform, including generation of engagement and support recommendations for content creators, augmented reality identification of subscribers at live events, and generation of subscription and creator page recommendations. It is also developing techniques to recommend benefit types, prices, and tax classification, process payments, visualize subscriber behavior, control benefit quality, and resolve fraud work items, covering recommendation, monetization, compliance, visualization, and security.

overview_description.description:
Patreon is a membership platform that makes it easy for artists and creators to get paid. It operates a platform that enables content creators, as well as artists, to be able to fund their work. It's Patreon.com, a communications platform,  enables connection between users and makes various accessible content, including videos, photographs, images, artwork, graphics, audio clips, comments, data, text, software, scripts, projects, other material and information, and associated trademarks and copyrightable works.

Patrons pledge to support artists and creators on a recurring basis for each work created, empowering a new generation of creators the ability to make a living off of their passions.

product.name: Patreon Creator Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for creators to publish exclusive content, manage fan access, and operate a direct-to-audience creative business.

product.name: Patreon Paid Memberships
product.description: A subscription-management service that lets creators offer recurring monthly or annual memberships with tiered access to exclusive content and benefits.

product.name: Patreon Digital Products and Shops
product.description: An online commerce service for listing and selling individual digital products, including videos, podcast episodes, music, tutorials, game mods, and downloadable files.

product.name: Patreon Payments
product.description: A payment infrastructure service that processes fan payments, creator payouts, fraud monitoring, payment recovery, currency conversion, and applicable tax handling.

product.name: Patreon Newsletter
product.description: A newsletter publishing and email distribution service for creating, sending, and monetizing written updates and multimedia content to subscribers and other contacts.

product.name: Patreon Podcast Tools
product.description: A podcast hosting and distribution service for importing shows, managing multiple podcasts, publishing exclusive episodes, and distributing feeds through Patreon and partner integrations.
